references.text: Moses designated three cities of refuge on the east side of the Jordan, which is the first fulfillment of the commandment regarding cities of refuge.
Earlier in the same chapter, the command is given to set apart three cities and make the roads to them accessible.
The promise of three additional cities if Israel expands its territory, showing that the three cities mentioned in verse 7 are only the beginning.
The law concerning cities of refuge in Numbers, which establishes six cities in total, three on each side of the Jordan.
The fulfillment of the command when Joshua actually designated the six cities of refuge in Canaan.
The earliest mention of a place of refuge for someone who kills unintentionally, forming the basis for the system of cities of refuge.
